messages:
sara_support: Hey team — new customer (Org: tiny-analytics) is hitting a lot of 429s overnight on the free tier during their nightly ingestion. They claim it's a short burst for a one-time import. Request ID in logs: req_0b9f2a. Can we advise a safe short-term path?

enrique_oncall: Can you paste the exact error and any rate header values? 429 alone doesn't show concurrency vs quota.

sara_support: Log excerpt: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Tue, 23 May 2025 03:04:12 GMT
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1684829052
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "message": "Free plan concurrency exceeded"
}
```
They're doing ~8k small embedding calls over 10 minutes from a single key.

morgan_sales: tagging to evaluate temporary uplift: @morgan_sales. Sara, do we have their billing profile? Free signups only. We can offer a timeboxed paid trial credit or temporary burst exemption if product approves. Need expected QPS and business case.

kai_cust_success: I already asked the customer for expected ingest size and ETA. They want a one-off import for demo tomorrow, ~8k requests in a 10–15m window. Will follow up with their ETA.

enrique_oncall: Short-term mitigation: advise batching (combine items into bulk embedding calls) or stagger ingestion. Also reduce token usage per request when possible. For immediate relief we can create a temporary rate-limit exception for up to 15 minutes but need an approval and a note in the ticket.

sara_support: Customer asked if we can "just turn it up for a few minutes" — what's the formal process?

morgan_sales: Process: 1) Customer provides org ID + expected QPS + timestamp window. 2) Sales + Support approve for demo / trial. 3) We create a short-lived override in the quota service (max 30m). Need engineering runbook signoff.

alex_engineer: FYI the quota service requires the override payload: `{ "org": "tiny-analytics", "limit_type": "concurrency", "value": 2000, "expires_at": 1684829999 }`. Ping me and I'll apply if authorized. Also we should check burst routing to Dedicated fallback — not available for free.

sara_support: Customer sent ETA: tomorrow 2025-05-23 03:00 UTC. They're okay with a 20 minute window. QPS spike estimate = 9k calls/10m -> ~15 rps.

enrique_oncall: 15 rps from one key is okay for paid tiers but above free concurrency limit. I recommend: 1) Offer immediate guidance: show batching curl example and headers to inspect; 2) Offer temporary uplift (15–20m) + ask them to switch to paid after demo.

sara_support: Batching example I gave them: 
```
# combine 50 items into one request
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-1","inputs":["text1","text2",...]}'
```

morgan_sales: I'll prep a one-time promo offer and CC finance if they want a short paid trial. If they don't want to pay, we can still approve a one-off exception but prefer paid.

kai_cust_success: Customer replied: "We can go paid for the demo if that speeds things up. How long does onboarding to paid take?"

enrique_oncall: Paid upgrade is instant from our billing side if card is added; quota increases apply immediately on payment. For manual temporary exception, we need 1) written customer request, 2) internal approval. Estimated turnaround 15–30 minutes.

sara_support: I've asked customer to attach org ID and confirm the exact 20 minute window and their contact. Also asked them to rotate keys if they reached a leaked key suspicion.

alex_engineer: One more troubleshooting tip: ask them to surface `X-RateLimit-Remaining` on each request and log `X-Request-ID`. If they see Remaining going to 0 quickly, it's strictly quota. If header stays >0 but they still see 429s, it's concurrency limits (burst queue).

sara_support: Putting a checklist in the ticket for the approval flow and steps. If sales approves paid, they'll get immediate capacity. If we do exception, I'll request @alex_engineer to apply the override. :thumbsup:

morgan_sales: Approving the paid trial route as primary. I'll DM finance to pre-clear a small promo credit. :money_with_wings:

rate-limit-bot: Automated note — org tiny-analytics exceeded free-tier concurrency of 60 at 2025-05-23T03:04:12Z. Auto-block enforced.

sara_support: Closing loop: Customer chose paid. They completed card steps at 2025-05-23T02:30 UTC and we confirmed immediate capacity. They still want docs on batching best practices — sending links. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
